anomalies.observed: On the MAIN PUMP & VALVE DRIVERS sheet, the ATO Valve low-side switch is drawn as T3 with value AO3400A.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that T3 is an AON6407 8-DFN N-MOSFET used as the ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch.

evidence.quote: T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch

anomalies.impact: The ATO valve is switched by a different MOSFET than intended, potentially with lower voltage/current/thermal margin and different gate-drive behavior; the valve switching may be unreliable or the part may overheat/fail.

anomalies.observed: In the PERISTALTIC PUMP DRIVERS sheet, each TMC2209 5VOUT pin is connected to a global +5V power symbol and to the top of its VREF-setting resistor divider.
anomalies.expected: The specification says each TMC2209 5VOUT is not tied to the board main +5V rail; it should form a local per-driver reference rail (/5V_pH, /5V_NA, /5V_NB) for the current-reference divider.

evidence.quote: Each TMC2209 ... internal 5V linear regulator output ("5VOUT") that is NOT tied to the board's main +5V rail ... i.e. a per-driver reference rail, not a shared supply.

anomalies.impact: The internal 5V regulator outputs are paralleled/back-fed with the buck +5V rail, which can corrupt the motor current reference, cause regulator contention, or damage the drivers.

anomalies.observed: The WATER LEVEL SENSOR/SWITCHES sheet shows a LiDAR water-height sensor PR4 connected through H4 to +5V and the main I2C nets NET0057/NET0033.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the TF-Luna LiDAR is present but not wired, and the wired water-level sensing path is an ultrasonic sensor on GPIOs, not an I2C LiDAR.

evidence.quote: Water Height Sensor ... PR4 LiDAR ... NET0057 ... NET0033

TF-Luna LiDAR module (PR1) ... its pins are "free" ... not wired into any net ... water-level sensing that is actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs.

anomalies.impact: The board contains an implemented I2C LiDAR water-level path that the documented firmware does not use, changing the sensor behavior and adding an unexpected I2C device/load.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains at least two clear deviations from the intended r2 design: the ATO valve MOSFET is AO3400A instead of the specified AON6407, and the TMC2209 5VOUT pins are tied to the global +5V rail rather than kept as local reference rails. A third likely deviation is the LiDAR water-height sensor being wired to I2C despite the specification documenting the LiDAR as unwired.
